biotools.summary: fastDFE is a Python-based software package for fast and flexible inference of the distribution of fitness effects (DFE) from site-frequency spectrum (SFS) data. It provides efficient joint inference, introduces genomic covariates, and includes comprehensive VCF-to-SFS parsing utilities with various annotation options.
